findings.title: Retry cascade duplicates persisted Mermaid imports
findings.why_it_matters: A trusted client can treat idempotentHint as permission to retry an interrupted call. Each retry of open_mermaid_file succeeds and persists another UUID-named BPMN diagram, so a timeout or aggressive retry loop can fill the local store with duplicates while every annotation verification layer still reports success.
findings.suggested_fix: Classify open_mermaid_file as ADDITIVE with idempotentHint: false, update its explicit expected tuple, and add a repeated-call probe asserting that identical calls produce distinct files so the non-idempotent behavior cannot be relabeled accidentally.
evidence: Trigger: src/server/tools.ts:593 assigns IDEMPOTENT_UPDATE, whose idempotentHint is true, to open_mermaid_file.

Execution path: src/server/handlers.ts:298-313 converts and imports on every call; src/core/SimpleBpmnEngine.ts:931-933 assigns a default filename and persists it; defaultFilename at lines 1430-1441 embeds a fresh UUID.
Observed failure: two identical open_mermaid_file calls both succeeded, changed the active filename, and grew the temporary directory from one generated .bpmn file to two generated .bpmn files.

Verification cascade: tests/contracts/tool-annotations.test.ts:52 copies the incorrect tuple, while its repeat probe at lines 152-171 exercises only update_element and save; scripts/package-smoke.mjs:432-446 derives expected annotations from the same built tool definitions, so source, bundle, and packed executable all agree on the same false hint and the checks pass.
